# Description Clause

A root-local clause containing authored descriptive content, independent of catalog data, prices, parties, and workflows. Its content describes rather than executes behavior.

- `parameters.title`: the authored title, as text.
- `parameters.text`: the authored descriptive text.
- `parameters.sections`: optional sections. Each section has a `title`, optional `text`, and optional `bullets` containing a list of text.

No parameter defaults are defined. Changing these parameters changes descriptive content, not executable behavior.

The clause declares no actions, guards, effects, or mutable state. Its `plan` returns empty `contracts`, `reads`, and `states`. Both `validateConfiguration` and `validateTransition` always return `allowed: true` with an empty `code`, so this clause itself adds no configuration or transition restrictions.
